metadata.task_name: Macro Name Validation and sessionStorage Lifecycle

execution.coverage: 100% — all four target files read plus GXUtils.ts for pattern definition

finding.preliminary_assessment: MacroComponent.onDeleteMacro() passes this.selectedMacro directly to the ApplinX REST MacroService.deleteMacro() API without any validation against the MACRO_NAME_PATTERN regex defined in GXUtils. The HTML template does enforce a pattern on the RECORD macro input field (line 40: pattern='^[a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'), but the DELETE, VIEW, and PLAY operations use dropdown selects populated from macroFileList sessionStorage, with no client-side pattern validation applied to selectedMacro, selectedViewMacro, or selectedPlayMacro values. If macroFileList in sessionStorage contains manipulated values (possible via prior XSS or direct sessionStorage manipulation), or if a macro file exists on the server with a path-traversal name created through a different mechanism, the macro name could contain '../' sequences that are forwarded to server-side file operations without sanitization. Impact depends on whether the ApplinX REST API server validates macro names server-side. Additionally, a modal state inconsistency was found: delete modal binds to selectedDelMacro but onDeleteMacro() reads this.selectedMacro — could cause wrong macro to be deleted.

patterns_observed: Record macro input has pattern validation in HTML template (line 40)
Delete/view/play operations have NO pattern validation on selectedMacro
macroFileList comma-split: comma in macro name would corrupt the list
macroFileList NOT cleared on logout in setNotConnected() — TM-007 gap
JSON.parse(rawUserName) in ngOnInit without try-catch — crash on malformed JSON
Modal state variables inconsistency: selectedDelMacro vs this.selectedMacro in onDeleteMacro()
console.log() statements at lines 231, 235, 239, 272 log macro names and API responses

false_positives.pattern: Macro name pattern in HTML template
false_positives.rationale: Pattern validation IS present for the record macro input (line 40 of HTML) — only missing for delete/view/play operations which use dropdown selects

analysis.coverage_assessment: Complete — macro.component.ts, macro.component.html, shared.service.ts, storage.service.ts, and GXUtils.ts all analyzed. All macro lifecycle operations traced.
